notes: Merged -2 variant, which FT also lists under change over time.

name: Connected scatterplot
notes: Merged -2 variant, which FT also lists under change over time.

notes: d2v version uses the gapminder R package.

name: XY heatmap
notes: d2v heatmap is a clustered matrix heatmap on multivariate.csv.

name: Dot strip plot
notes: Merged -2 variant, which FT lists under distribution.

notes: Merged -2 variant (change over time; data slope-2.csv). RAWGraphs slope_football is an alt-dataset row.

notes: FT dot plot shows min and max per category (a range dot plot).

name: Area chart
notes: Gramener spec is a stacked area by category. Merged d2v area (one series) and stackedarea (babynames R package).

name: Priestley timeline (Gantt)
notes: Merged with RAWGraphs ganttChart: both draw one interval bar per entity on a time axis. Gantt adds several intervals per row and a color field; see the alt-dataset row.

name: Bar / column chart
notes: Merged orientation and sort variants: FT column (magnitude and change over time) and FT ordered bar and ordered column (ranking).

name: Paired (grouped) bar
notes: Merged paired column. RAWGraphs multiset-dates is an alt-dataset row.

name: Marimekko
notes: Merged -2 variant, which FT lists under part-to-whole.

name: Proportional symbol
notes: Merged the ordered variant (ranking; data ordered-proportional-symbol.csv).

name: Isotype (pictogram)
notes: Inline data is a single value (14).

name: Radar
notes: d2v list_all.txt names spider but has no Rmd at the pinned commit.

notes: d2v version uses iris.

name: Grouped symbol
notes: Inline data, 25 rows.

name: Stacked column
notes: RAWGraphs barchartstacked-dates is an alt-dataset row.

name: Arc (parliament hemicycle)
notes: FT arc is a half donut of seats. Not the d2v arc diagram (see arc-diagram).

name: Gridplot (waffle)
notes: Inline data is a single percentage (32 of 100 squares).

notes: Inline data is one row of two sets and their overlap. d2v venn uses 14_SeveralIndepLists.csv.

notes: Inline data, 8 rows. Merged -2 variant (5 rows), which FT lists under flow.

notes: The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

notes: d2v list_all.txt names connection (a flow map) but has no Rmd at the pinned commit. The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Contour map
notes: Geographic isolines. Not the same as density-2d. The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Equalised cartogram
notes: The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Scaled cartogram
notes: d2v cartogram also reads a population CSV from r-graph-gallery.com, which cannot be pinned. The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Dot density map
notes: The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Heat map (geographic grid)
notes: FT spatial heat map. Not the xy-heatmap. The spec also reads parallel-coordinates.csv for values.

name: Sankey
notes: Gramener inline data is 6 links between 3 nodes. d2v uses a 10-region migration matrix (13_AdjacencyDirectedWeighted.csv), a richer candidate.

name: Chord diagram
notes: Gramener inline data, 6 rows. d2v uses 13_AdjacencyDirectedWeighted.csv.

name: Network
notes: stretch: force-directed layout. Gramener inline nodes and links, 13 rows.

name: Arc diagram
notes: Nodes on a line joined by arcs. Not FT arc (parliament-arc). RAWGraphs also has arcdiagram.

name: Dendrogram
notes: FT has no hierarchy family; placed with network charts. The page also builds a small hierarchy in code.

name: 2D density
notes: stretch: needs 2D kernel density and contouring. Data is random normal draws in code. Same chart as RAWGraphs contourPlot; not the geographic contour-map.

name: Hierarchical edge bundling
notes: stretch: radial tree layout plus bundled curves.

name: Ridgeline
notes: Data is zonination/perceptions probly.csv (MIT), pinned.

name: Sunburst
notes: FT chartTypes.csv lists sunburst under part-to-whole; Gramener has no spec for it.

name: Hexbin map
notes: Geographic hex grid. Not the same as hexbin (RAWGraphs hexagonalBinning).

name: Word cloud
exclude_reason: word cloud: text packing, not a data chart

name: Alluvial diagram
notes: Mapping: steps = Class, Survival, Age group, Gender. Titanic passengers, 1309 rows. Existing data/titanic.json is a separate copy used by create-mosaic-nested.

name: Horizon graph
notes: Mapping: group = group, x = xpos, y = sum(value); negativeStyle mirrored, 3 bands.

name: Beeswarm
notes: Mapping: xValue = Year, series = Genre, color = Genre, size = Budget (Millions, adjusted for inflation), label = Title + Year.

name: Convex hull
notes: Mapping: x = Budget (Millions, adjusted for inflation), y = Year. The config leaves group commented out, so one hull wraps all points.

name: Voronoi treemap
notes: Mapping: hierarchy = Root, Level1, Level2; size = sum(results); color = Root. stretch: weighted Voronoi layout.

name: Hexagonal binning
notes: Mapping: x = Budget (Millions, adjusted for inflation), y = Box Office (Millions, adjusted for inflation). Not the geographic hexbin-map.

name: Bump chart (bank rankings)
notes: alt-dataset of bump. Mapping: streams = Bank, x = Year, size = Rank. RAWGraphs draws bumps as ribbons sized by value; the task should use rank lines.

name: Slope chart (football points)
notes: alt-dataset of slope. Mapping: source = 2018-2019, target = 2019-2020, name = Teams, color = Status, series = Championship. No example config at the pinned commit; mapping is from the chart's dimensions.js and the dataset columns.

name: Grouped bar (dates)
notes: alt-dataset of paired-bar. Mapping: groups = date, bars = sum(first). Dataset has only 2 rows and 2 series (first, second); too small as is.

name: Stacked column (dates)
notes: alt-dataset of stacked-column. Mapping: stacks = date, bars = sum(first), sum(second). Dataset has only 2 rows; too small as is.

name: Gantt (Italian prime ministers and presidents)
notes: alt-dataset of priestley-timeline. Mapping: group = Politician, startDate = Start date, endDate = End date, color = Role.
